historicalEvidenceImmutability.detail: research-evidence/r3-l0c-g0, r3-l0c-g1, r3-l0c-g1b and r3-l0c-iar are byte-identical; the G1 evidence tree hash is 4c98ca488c20ae00722ebd802243e936ed587bc2 and the G1-B tree hash is 571e6019dbe2cf66c98743f8a7e94a7b9e74c92c, both unchanged from the baseline

fullSuite.detail: The 15 failures are the archived R3-L0C execution-plan closure-binding family. They are NOT caused by T0 — proven by a single-variable experiment below.

singleVariableProof.method: An isolated git worktree at the EXACT baseline commit fae6c668685a23da6839da3069707d3de2e91121 (with no src/trajectory and no dist/src/trajectory) was built and the identical test files were run in isolation.
singleVariableProof.conclusion: Every archived-plan failure reproduces identically at the baseline commit with zero T0 code present. T0 introduces 0 new failures and fixes 0 (fixing them is out of scope and would require weakening a closure guard, which the ruling forbids).
singleVariableProof.singleVariableChanged: src/trajectory/** + src/composition/trajectory.ts + tools/architecture/layers.ts (one classification line) + test/trajectory_t0_*.test.ts

archivedClosureDriftClassification.reason: The archived R3-L0C execution plans bind an EXECUTION_CLOSURE digest computed over the runtime manifest of dist/src modules (RUNTIME_MANIFEST_MODULES) plus a source-import graph. Adding a new src/ module necessarily moves that digest, so the archived plan's recorded closure cannot match a changed source tree. This is the same class of drift the G1-B stage recorded as ARCHIVED_PLAN_COMPATIBILITY = DRIFTED_EXPECTED.

batchNondeterminism.observed: Running the eight archived-plan gate files together at a FIXED commit produced 15, then 16, then 20 failures across three runs; the same files in isolation are stable.
batchNondeterminism.cause: A known shared-resource race in that family (the shared DSH profile installation under ~/.dsh/profiles, previously reported by the G1-B stage under six workers). It is present at the baseline commit too.
batchNondeterminism.t0Involvement: None. T0 has zero references to the shared profile installer, and the same nondeterminism reproduces at the baseline.
batchNondeterminism.mitigation: All T0 verification used per-file isolation and --maxWorkers=4; no shared profile installer was run concurrently.

unsafeLegacyTests.detail: The known unsafe isolated-mutation cleanup test was not run against shared dependencies; the T0 work-rework scenario uses its own tmpdir repository and a FakeGitPort.

browserE2e: NOT_RUN — no UI surface was modified (the ruling permits this omission).
